core_features: znet Web framework (HTTP server with routing, middleware, group routing, template engine, SSE, JSON-RPC support)
zhttp HTTP client (GET/POST/PUT/DELETE etc., fluent request builder with object pool, retry mechanism, proxy support, file upload/download with progress)
zlog logging library (multiple log levels, color output, file archiving, module-level independent config, Dump/Track/Stack debug tools)
zjson JSON processing (Marshal/Unmarshal with type conversion, Get/Set on raw JSON paths, array/slice helpers)
zcache in-memory cache (TTL expiration, LRU eviction, namespace isolation)
zdi dependency injection container (struct tag binding, singleton/transient scoping, pre-invocation hooks)
zfile file operations (path manipulation, file detection, directory traversal, file locking)
zvalid data validation (struct tag validation, custom rules, chainable validators with error aggregation)
zpool goroutine pool (worker pool with task queue, dynamic scaling, context-aware lifecycle)
zerror error handling (stack trace attachment, multi-error aggregation, typed error wrapping)
